title: nixos/snapserver: migrate to settings option
reason: Applicable: real snapserver module + wired test (same module as S5-A batch3's PR444033). Real diff is a large rewrite converting from a manual streamToOption/optionString config-generation approach to a real pkgs.formats.ini settings-based module.
targets_toml: single target snapserver, cfg_ident=cfg, option_prefix=[services,snapserver], watch=[package].

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: 4th instance of the mkPackageOption non-discovery gap (tally: gonic/dex/n8n, this one). Confirmed via discovered_options: 13 real options found (enable, settings.*, openFirewall) but package (a real mkPackageOption declaration, unchanged by this diff) is absent from the list at both sides.
